python3 -c "
import statistics
cap = [330, 800, 2000, 160, 520, 45, 44, 240]
yr = [2016, 2013, 2014, 2011, 2012, 2011, 2011, 2011]
n = len(cap)
mx, my = sum(cap)/n, sum(yr)/n
cov = sum((x-mx)*(y-my) for x,y in zip(cap,yr))/n
sx = (sum((x-mx)**2 for x in cap)/n)**0.5
sy = (sum((y-my)**2 for y in yr)/n)**0.5
r = cov/(sx*sy)
print(f'Correlation: {r:.2f}')
"
